description: Money-market and policy rates from the central banks themselves: SOFR, TGCR, BGCR, EFFR and OBFR from the New York Fed (with percentiles and volume), the euro short-term rate and the ECB's policy rates, SONIA and Bank Rate from the Bank of England, and about forty central banks' policy rates as the BIS collects them (policy:JP, policy:Brazil). Dates and rates, oldest first.

rate.description: sofr, tgcr, bgcr, effr or obfr (New York Fed); estr, ecb_deposit, ecb_refi or ecb_marginal (ECB); sonia or bank_rate (Bank of England); or policy:<country>, a central bank's policy rate as the BIS collects it (policy:JP, policy:Brazil, policy:euro area).

start.description: First date; default 90 days before end.

name: reference_rates

outputSchema.description: rows are dates and rates in percent a year, oldest first; New York Fed rates add percentiles and volume.

title: Reference and policy rates
